title: 第一卷 第106章 喂，这摩托车借我骑骑呗！
slug: 重生1989我一赌鬼带全家顿顿吃肉
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“建军，我让玲儿帮我拿进来就好了。”

只见已经洗干净，换好衣服的玲儿，从里面走了出来。

门关的太快了，王建军都没来得及抬头，只看见了一抹雪白，门就已经被关上了。

王建军看着站在自己面前，伸着手的玲儿，急忙将那小衣塞在衣服中间递给了她，然后自己便又走到了院子里。

这夏天真是太热了！

没过多久，冲完澡换上新衣服的李南枝从里面走了出来。

这里没有擦身子的毛巾，李南枝便胡乱的用脏衣服擦了一下。

但身上还有不少水渍，以至于新换的衣服有好几处都贴在身上，让她本就姣好的身材曲线展示的更加淋漓尽致。

李南枝显然也发现了这一点，有些不好意思的用手挡着。

“这的东西还是太少了，咱们赶快回去把被子什么的搬过来吧。”

李南枝害羞的说着，耳朵根都红了。

王建军笑了笑，直接将自己的外套脱了下来，披在了她身上，挡住了大半的春光。

“走，趁着天还没黑，咱们回家去！”

只不过回去的时候，玲儿这次不愿意坐在中间了，非要站在前面。

她个子矮，站着倒是不挡视线，只不过李南枝还是觉得在前面太危险了。

“玲儿乖，在后面和妈一块坐着，前面太危险了。”

可无论李南枝怎么劝，玲儿都只是摇着头，扶着摩托车，说什么都不肯动。

李南枝一时之间也没了办法。

“没事的，南枝，就让她站在前面吧，我两条腿在这挡着呢，不会掉下去的。”

“而且还有我的胳膊在这拦着，她站在前面倒是更安全，我开慢点。”

见王建军都这么说了，李南枝点了点头，也只好妥协了。

不过玲儿往前面这么一站，李南枝就直接坐在了王建军后面。

想到刚才王建军骑车的速度，她犹豫了一下，还是双手环住了王建军的腰，两个人紧紧的贴在一起。

王建军甚至能感受到，李南枝的发丝被风吹到了他的脸上，痒痒的，还夹杂着淡淡的清香。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Jianjun, I'll just ask Ling'er to bring it in for me."

I saw Ling'er, who had been washed and changed, walking out of it.

The door closed so quickly that Wang Jianjun didn't even have time to look up. He only saw a flash of white snow before the door was closed.

Wang Jianjun looked at Ling'er who was standing in front of him with her hand stretched out. He hurriedly stuffed the small clothes in the middle of his clothes and handed it to her, and then walked back to the yard.

It's so hot this summer!

Not long after, Li Nanzhi walked out after taking a shower and putting on new clothes.

There was no towel to wipe himself with, so Li Nanzhi wiped it with dirty clothes randomly.

But there were still a lot of water stains on her body, so that her new clothes stuck to her body in many places, making her already beautiful figure more vividly displayed.

Li Nanzhi obviously noticed this and blocked it with his hands in embarrassment.

"There are still too few things here. Let's go back quickly and bring the quilts and other things over."

Li Nanzhi said shyly, his ears turning red.

Wang Jianjun smiled, took off his coat and put it on her body, blocking most of the spring light.

"Come on, let's go home before it gets dark!"

It's just that when we went back, Ling'er didn't want to sit in the middle this time and insisted on standing in the front.

She is short, so standing does not block her sight, but Li Nanzhi still feels that it is too dangerous to be in front.

"Ling'er, be good and sit with mom in the back. It's too dangerous in front."

But no matter how Li Nanzhi tried to persuade her, Ling'er just shook her head, held on to the motorcycle and refused to move.

Li Nanzhi was helpless for a while.

"It's okay, Nanzhi, just let her stand in front. My legs are here to block her, so she won't fall."

"And since my arm is here to stop her, it's safer for her to stand in front. I'll drive slower."

Seeing that Wang Jianjun had said so, Li Nanzhi nodded and had no choice but to compromise.

But as soon as Ling'er stopped in front, Li Nanzhi sat directly behind Wang Jianjun.

Thinking of the speed at which Wang Jianjun was riding his bicycle just now, she hesitated for a moment, then put her hands around Wang Jianjun's waist, and the two of them pressed together tightly.

Wang Jianjun could even feel that Li Nanzhi's hair was blown by the wind onto his face, itching and mixed with a faint fragrance.
